# San Diego Rebellion

The San Diego Revolution is a women's American football team based in San Diego, California. The Revolution play in the Pacific Division of the Women's National Football Conference. Home games are played at Escondido High School in Escondido, California.
History
The team was founded in 2017 by Katie Ott and Knengi Martin. The team originally played in the Women's Football Alliance before joining the WNFC in 2019.
2026 season
The team will play six games between March and May 2026.
